{{Quote|I don't know how they picked Okator VIII. It doesn't really matter, I suppose. It could have been a lot of places in the Divide. They could have picked Matabre, or Ilamna or Cortilium Major. But they didn't. They picked Okator.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''The Divide''' was a region that existed during the [[Tionese War]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> starting in [[24,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It contained the [[Cortilium Major system/Legends|Cortilium Major]], [[Ilamna system/Legends|Ilamna]], [[Matabre system/Legends|Matabre]], and [[Okator system/Legends|Okator systems]], which were home to the astronomical objects [[Cortilium Major]], [[Ilamna]], [[Matabre]], and [[Okator VIII]], respectively.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of the Divide eventually constituted a part of the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

The celestial bodies of the Divide were settled by Republic [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. Shortly before the Tionese War ended<ref name="Author's Cut" /> around [[23,900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] military force [[Attack on Okator VIII|destroyed]] several Republic settlements on Okator VIII. [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|One]] witness of the attack, a local [[Farmer/Legends|farm boy]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Republic soldier]], later narrated an account of the attack in a [[Baragwin sense lattice]], noting that the Tionese could have just as well chosen as their target any of the other settled astronomical objects of the Divide.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Divide was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the region was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Divide was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
